coverImage.name: Mandatory High-CTR Cover / Hook Thumbnail
coverImage.promptTemplate: A dramatic, high-CTR YouTube Shorts cover and thumbnail illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920), Graphic Novel Neo-Noir style. Visual Scene: A chilling crime scene hook depicting {CASE_HERO_VISUAL}. Integrated Bold Typography: Prominent massive distressed headline text: '{MAIN_HEADLINE}' rendered in heavy stencil/impact typography in warm broken-white (#E6EDF3) with antique brass bronze accents (#C59B27) and deep drop shadows. symbolicAllegory.name: Symbolic Allegory (Judicial & Narrative Climaxes)

forensicEvidenceDesk.name: Forensic Evidence Desk (Isometric Investigation)
forensicEvidenceDesk.promptTemplate: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Subject: Isometric 45-degree angle top-down view of a police forensic evidence desk examining {EVIDENCE_OBJECTS}. Composition: Full bleed vertical framing. Forensic items tightly arranged across a matte dark graphite workbench with tactical grid markings. Rich foreground-to-background spatial layers. Style: Gritty investigative graphic novel noir, crisp black inked linework, fine halftone dot shading, tactile matte paper and metallic textures. Color palette: Matte charcoal slate (#0D1117), cold metallic gray, antique dull bronze (#C59B27), dried crimson red stamps (#8B2635). Lighting: Harsh single desk examination lamp casting long dramatic shadows across the table. Invariants: Full bleed composition, no UI overlays, no digital watermarks.
